title: Intra-Epidermal Fiber Density Measurement Protocol
author: Eva L. Feldman
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.563g9gn

steps.title: Fix Tissue
steps.instruction: Remove the footpad from a fresh mouse or rat and fix it in 2% zamboni’s fixative (in phosphate buffer, 0.1 M, pH 7.4) for 4-6 hours.

steps.title: Cryoprotect Tissue
steps.instruction: Place the skin in 30% sucrose in 1x PBS overnight.

steps.title: Embed and Section Tissue
steps.instruction: Embed the tissue in OCT and cut sections.

substeps.instruction: Place sections into a single well of a 24 well plate.

steps.title: Block Tissue
steps.instruction: Block the sections for 1-2 hours in blocking solution.

steps.title: Apply Primary Antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate with primary antibody (Ptroteintech rabbit anti-PGP9.5(14730-1-ap), 1:2000).

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature (RT) for 1 hour.

steps.title: Rinse Sections
steps.instruction: Rinse the sections 3 times for 1 hour each in PBS.

steps.title: Apply Secondary Antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate with secondary antibody (AlexaFluor 488 highly cross absorbed, 1:1000, Molecular Probes).

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature (RT) for 1 hour.

steps.title: Final Rinse and Coverslipping
steps.instruction: Perform final rinse and apply coverslips.

substeps.instruction: Rinse 3 times for 1 hour each in PBS.
Apply coverslips using ProLong gold or platinum antifade kit with dapi (Molecular Probes).

steps.title: Image Samples
steps.instruction: Collect images using an Olympus FluoView 500 confocal microscope.

substeps.instruction: Collect three images per sample using a 20 X air objective.
Flatten 10 images per stack using MetaMorph (version 7.70) arithmetic max option.
